title: Cutaway Volute Pump Display
description: One new whole static cutaway volute-pump display. An entire spiral-expanding thick casing has a real front opening and annular rear wall, around a separate backplate, central hub and six continuously curved impeller blades. A front axial annular intake collar remains supported by three fixed narrow bridges where the front cover is deliberately removed; a tall tangential annular outlet neck rises beside the cutoff. One grounded bed supports the casing feet, rear common shaft, two bored bearing pedestals and a double-flanged drive pulley. The new radial impeller/expanding collection casing/tangential branch topology differs from the old straight open axial-fan duct and from old vertical lever or twin-treadle piston-style pumps. All geometry newly authored rather than extracted or rearranged old objects. Three opaque constant PBR roles; closed editable solids, metres, Z up and whole horizontal ground-centred datum. One prop, zero scenes. Simplified fixed illustrative joins only; the exposed cutaway is not a sealed hydraulic chamber. Outlet neck root is a static overlap, not a validated continuous fluid passage. No rotation, pumping, pressure, flow, sealing, efficiency, belt engagement, manufacture, structural performance or equipment safety claim.
